high_level_description: One continuous side-view 2.5D pixel-art battle environment. Extend the existing scenery at the RIGHT naturally to the LEFT. Same ground plane, same material scale, same illumination and pixel clusters. The bare outskirts of the same burial region. Flat worn ash ground with a few small half-buried rounded limestone slabs. The rear edge is a low eroded bank with one broken burial marker at the RIGHT, joining the existing ruins there. The far LEFT is sparse open ash with a low pale distant ridge. No monumental architecture.

style_description.art_style: Crisp native pixel clusters, organic irregular shapes, subtly chipped edges, three or four flat tones per material. Broad quiet surfaces. Precise stepped pixel contours. Match the connected existing pixels on the right. No painted brush strokes, fine texture, dithering, blur or tiny gravel.
style_description.aesthetics: quiet connected ancient game environment, restrained detail, subdued low contrast ground
style_description.lighting: Even soft upper-left lighting in discrete pixel planes

compositional_deconstruction.background: Muted ash-limestone, dusty sepia, violet-brown shadow, dull ochre. A dry ancient burial region with soft uneven stone forms, eroded roots and funerary architecture. Continuous flat walkable ground across the whole lower two thirds. Camera slightly elevated SIDE battle view, not top-down or an isometric map. Ground extends to left, right and bottom. Quiet paving shapes about 60-140 pixels wide and 20-55 pixels deep, partly buried in dust; not gigantic slabs.

elements.desc: The bare outskirts of the same burial region. Flat worn ash ground with a few small half-buried rounded limestone slabs. The rear edge is a low eroded bank with one broken burial marker at the RIGHT, joining the existing ruins there. The far LEFT is sparse open ash with a low pale distant ridge. No monumental architecture. All obstacles confined to the rear upper third. No people or living statues.

A wide clear fighting plane with the same height and perspective as the adjoining right-hand ground. Irregular low-contrast paving interrupted by broad smooth dust. No hills, stairs, cliffs, holes, props or fencing in the battle lanes. No repeated square tile grid.
